mapper.sql: r.*, reporter.nickname AS reporter_nickname, CASE WHEN r.report_type = 'USER' THEN user_target.id WHEN r.report_type = 'NEWS_COMMENT' THEN news_comment_user.id ELSE comment_user.id END AS reported_user_id, COALESCE(user_target.username, news_comment_user.username, comment_user.username) AS reported_username, COALESCE(user_target_info.nickname, news_comment_target_info.nickname, comment_target_info.nickname) AS reported_nickname, COALESCE(user_target_info.avatar, news_comment_target_info.avatar, comment_target_info.avatar) AS reported_avatar, COALESCE(user_target.enable_flag, news_comment_user.enable_flag, comment_user.enable_flag) AS reported_enable_flag, c.post_id, COALESCE(p.title, n.title) AS post_title, nc.news_id, n.title AS news_title, COALESCE(c.content, nc.content) AS comment_content, COALESCE(c.create_time, nc.create_time) AS comment_create_time

SELECT id, username, enable_flag FROM t_player_user WHERE deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT id, username, enable_flag FROM t_moderator_user WHERE deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT id, username, enable_flag FROM t_admin_user WHERE deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM t_report r
r.deleted = 0
AND r.status LIKE 'MUTE:%'
AND (r.status = 'BANNED' OR r.status LIKE 'BAN:%')
AND (r.status = 'PENDING' OR r.status IS NULL OR r.appeal_status = 'PENDING')
AND r.status = #{param.status}
AND r.report_type = #{param.reportType}
AND r.user_id = #{param.userId}
AND ( (r.report_type = 'USER' AND r.reported_id = #{param.reportedUserId}) OR (r.report_type = 'COMMENT' AND c.user_id = #{param.reportedUserId}) OR (r.report_type = 'NEWS_COMMENT' AND nc.user_id = #{param.reportedUserId}) )
AND ( COALESCE(user_target.username, news_comment_user.username, comment_user.username) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.reportedKeyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(user_target_info.nickname, news_comment_target_info.nickname, comment_target_info.nickname) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.reportedKeyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT
FROM t_report r
WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.deleted = 0

SELECT
FROM t_report r
WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND ( (r.report_type = 'USER' AND r.reported_id = #{userId}) OR (r.report_type = 'COMMENT' AND c.user_id = #{userId}) OR (r.report_type = 'NEWS_COMMENT' AND nc.user_id = #{userId}) ) AND ( r.status = 'BANNED' OR r.status LIKE 'BAN:%' OR r.status LIKE 'MUTE:%' ) ORDER BY r.update_time DESC, r.create_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.* FROM t_report r LEFT JOIN t_comment c ON r.report_type = 'COMMENT' AND r.reported_id = c.id LEFT JOIN t_news_comment nc ON r.report_type = 'NEWS_COMMENT' AND r.reported_id = nc.id WHERE ( (r.report_type = 'USER' AND r.reported_id = #{userId}) OR (r.report_type = 'COMMENT' AND c.user_id = #{userId}) OR (r.report_type = 'NEWS_COMMENT' AND nc.user_id = #{userId}) ) AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status LIKE 'MUTE:%'
mapper.update: UPDATE t_report r LEFT JOIN t_comment c ON r.report_type = 'COMMENT' AND r.reported_id = c.id LEFT JOIN t_news_comment nc ON r.report_type = 'NEWS_COMMENT' AND r.reported_id = nc.id SET r.status = #{status}, r.reply = #{reply}, r.update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE ( (r.report_type = 'USER' AND r.reported_id = #{userId}) OR (r.report_type = 'COMMENT' AND c.user_id = #{userId}) OR (r.report_type = 'NEWS_COMMENT' AND nc.user_id = #{userId}) ) AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status LIKE 'MUTE:%'
